title: ANALISTA DE RELACIONAMENTO - VALINHOS/SP
description:
A SOMOS Educação é um dos principais grupos de educação básica do Brasil, oferecendo uma ampla variedade de soluções educacionais. Nossos serviços incluem sistemas de ensino, editoras, soluções de ensino complementares e uma plataforma tecnológica de aprendizado digital e e-commerce. Com isso, nos apresentamos como parceiros integrais das escolas.

Entre as marcas que compõem o nosso grupo estão Anglo, PH, Plurall, Líder em Mim e outras. Nossa missão é transformar o ecossistema das escolas privadas, combinando educação e gestão de alta qualidade com base na neurociência e na tecnologia em larga escala. Além disso, buscamos liderar as escolas no processo de transformação digital, visando ser o principal agente de reinvenção da educação para o aluno e a escola do século XXI.

Para cumprir essa missão e entregar o melhor para as nossas escolas, baseamos nosso trabalho em valores fundamentais. Valorizamos a autonomia e o apoio, o bem-estar, a excelência, a liderança e a inovação em nossa rotina de trabalho. Somos o único grupo educacional classificado como uma das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar, Great Place to Work – GPTW.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Comunicação ativa e passiva com gestores e profissionais responsáveis pelo marketing das novas escolas parceiras para orientações sobre o processo de embarque da escola na Somos Educação;
  • Comunicação ativa e passiva para divulgação de eventos, de ações de marketing e conteúdos disponíveis nos portais de marketing da Emme/selos;
  • Atendimento remoto às escolas que utilizam os serviços e conteúdos disponíveis em nossa Plataforma de Marketing Educacional;
  • Participar/realizar lives e encontros on-line para assessoria e apresentação de conteúdos destinados às novas escolas parceiras;
  • Acompanhamento e registro de participação e engajamento das novas escolas nas atividades e ações desenvolvidas para a jornada de boas-vindas;
  • Preenchimento de relatórios e planilhas.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação completa em cursos Comunicação, Publicidade, Ciência Social, Pedagogia;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Excel;
  • Experiência no relacionamento com clientes.

Perfil comportamental:

  • Boa comunicação oral e textual;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em plataformas online;
  • Bom relacionamento, habilidade para trabalho em equipe, compartilhamento de responsabilidades e organização;
  • Foco no cliente, resiliência e muita disposição.

Desejável:

  • Experiência em escolas de qualquer segmento;
  • Conhecimento em plataformas como CRM.

Informações adicionais:

Modelo de trabalho híbrido sendo 3x presencial em nosso escritório em Valinhos e 2x home office.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Conexa: Atendimento psicológico gratuito para cuidar da sua saúde mental.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Us

We're a rapidly growing energy focused startup specialising in ingesting, transforming, and delivering data from a wide range of third-party systems. Our platform integrates data via APIs, FTP, and other sources, processes it through our ETL pipelines before being made available to our customers.

As we scale, we're investing heavily in our data platform, with the aim of improving reliability, onboarding speed, and visibility. We're looking for an Integration Developer to help us take this to the next level.

The Role

You'll be responsible for building, maintaining, and improving our data integrations and pipelines. You'll work closely with existing engineers to extend our ETL framework, onboard new data sources, and develop internal tools that make our data easier to understand, trust, and scale.

This role suits someone who enjoys solving messy, real-world problems, is comfortable working at pace, and wants to grow into a senior engineer as the company grows.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and maintain data pipelines ingesting data from third-party systems.

Develop and extend Airflow DAGs to extract, transform, and load data.

Improve data traceability and observability.

Design and build internal tools, frameworks, or utilities to improve data onboarding and visibility.

Debug incomplete or poorly documented data problems independently.

Propose and evaluate new tools, technologies, and approaches where they make sense.

Balance delivery speed with long-term maintainability.

Collaborate closely with the wider team to continuously improve how we work.

What We're Looking For

Core skills

  • Strong Python experience
  • Solid SQL skills, ideally with Postgres
  • Comfortable working with data pipelines and ETL concepts
  • Ability to reason through problems independently and communicate your thinking

Nice to have

  • Experience with Apache Airflow
  • Familiarity with AWS (especially S3, IAM, basic infrastructure concepts)
  • Previous experience working with third-party integrations or external data sources
  • Knowledge of the renewable energy sector specifically solar

How You Work

  • Curious and enthusiastic about learning new technologies and approaches
  • Comfortable speaking up, asking questions, and proposing solutions
  • Pragmatic — understands trade-offs between speed and technical debt
  • Self-aware, open to feedback, and able to acknowledge limitations
  • Collaborative, easy to work with
  • Enjoys pushing the envelope and improving how things are done

Seniority

We are looking for someone with senior-level potential. You should be confident in your fundamentals, eager to take ownership, and excited to grow alongside the company.

Why Join Us

  • Real ownership over critical systems
  • Direct impact on how the platform evolves
  • Space to experiment, learn, and influence technical direction
  • A collaborative team that values pragmatism, curiosity, and continuous improvement

title: Business Analyst
description:
• We are looking for a Business Analyst with strong experience in FX Markets to join a global Technology & Change team working at the core of financial markets innovation.
    • This role offers the opportunity to contribute to high-impact initiatives across pricing, trading, eFX, and post-trade workflows, collaborating closely with both business and technology stakeholders in an international environment.
    • If you enjoy translating complex business needs into clear functional solutions and want to be part of large-scale transformation programs, this role is for you.

    Your Role & Responsibilities:

    As a Business Analyst – FX Markets, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering technology solutions that support trading and market activities.

    Requirements & Functional Analysis:

    • Gather and analyze business requirements across FX trading, pricing, liquidity, and market connectivity.
    • Translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
    • Define and maintain API requirements, including data models, message structures, and integration flows.
    • Map end-to-end processes and identify improvement opportunities aligned with digital transformation initiatives.

    Delivery & Stakeholder Collaboration:

    • Work closely with Front Office, Middle Office, Product Owners, Architects, and Technology teams.
    • Support test planning, QA clarification, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
    • Collaborate within a global, multi-disciplinary organization, ensuring alignment with governance and best practices.

    Documentation & Tools:

    • Produce clear, structured, and high-quality documentation using Jira and Confluence.
    • Leverage AI-based tools to improve efficiency in analysis, documentation, and communication.
    • Ensure functional artefacts are traceable, auditable, and aligned with internal standards.

    What We're Looking For:

    Must-Have Skills & Experience:

    • 3+ years of experience in FX Markets, including Spot, Forwards, Swaps, NDFs, or eFX.
    • Proven experience defining API and integration requirements.
    • Solid working knowledge of Jira and Confluence.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
    • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
    • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, stakeholder-rich environment.

    Nice to Have:

    • Experience with electronic trading platforms, market connectivity, or algorithmic trading.
    • Hands-on use of AI productivity tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Rovo).
    • Knowledge of FX regulatory frameworks (e.g. MiFID II).
    • Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
    • Basic knowledge of SQL or Python for data analysis and validation.

    What's in It for You:

    • Be part of high-visibility transformation initiatives within global FX and markets teams.
    • Work in a collaborative, international, and diverse environment.
    • Continuous learning and professional growth opportunities.
    • Exposure to cutting-edge technology and innovative market solutions.

title: Executivo de Contas Regionais - MT

description:

title: Pessoa Analista de Processos Operacionais Sênior | Banco
description:
O Banco Carrefour é a maior Fintail do Brasil e braço financeiro do Grupo Carrefour Brasil, único varejista com banco próprio. Com a missão de melhorar a vida das famílias brasileiras, dando acesso ao crédito e serviços financeiros inovadores, o Banco Carrefour é um dos maiores emissores de cartão de crédito do país, atendendo a milhões de brasileiros.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores e quer embarcar com a gente na missão de melhorar a vida das famílias brasileiras, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

#BancoCarrefour

Sobre a área:

Gerencia o ciclo de vida completo das plataformas de Core Banking, Conta Digital e Produtos PJ, garantindo alta disponibilidade, integridade de dados e conformidade. Por meio de uma abordagem de melhoria contínua e parametrização ágil, impulsiona a evolução do portfólio de serviços, assegurando uma jornada de excelência e processos end-to-end otimizados para clientes e parceiros.

Desafios dessa posição:

Governança dos projetos demandados pelas áreas de Negócios, apoiada por boas práticas e metodologias, com observância para toda superintendência de TI & Operações;

Acompanhar e analisar chamados técnicos bem como garantir o SLA e soluções que estejam aderentes as boas práticas de tecnologia;

Garantir a continuidade do serviço, assim identificando correções de bugs, atualização dos sistemas e implementação de melhorias;

Acionar fornecedores para cobrança de soluções definitivas e contorno;

Atuar em sala de crise, GMUD e homologar ações previamente agendadas com os times técnicos e negócio;

Responsável por criar políticas, procedimentos e fluxos operacionais baseados em regras e Negócios e TI, a fim de propor soluções definitivas e eficientes aos clientes e em normalidade com regulatórios;

Gestão do ciclo de vida dos projetos via metodologia Ágil (PI Planning, Dailies, Reviews), priorização de demandas de negócio e manutenção de boards no Kanbanize;

Orquestração de projetos complexos envolvendo múltiplas plataformas, com foco na mitigação de riscos, remoção de impedimentos e alinhamento de stakeholders;

Facilitação de POCs e MVPs, além da padronização de processos e documentos de boas práticas para a Superintendência.

Você precisa ter:

Experiência em Conta Digital e Produtos para Pessoa Jurídica (PJ);

Ensino superior completo;

Vivência com gestão e acompanhamento de projetos e processos.

Adoraríamos se você tiver:

Domínio do Pacote Office, com conhecimentos avançados em bancos de dados e linguagens de tecnologia;

Conhecimento da língua inglesa.

title: Assistente de aula bilíngue
description:
Descrição da Empresa Young Engineers São Paulo oferece aulas curriculares e extracurriculares de STEAM com robótica utilizando Lego, nas melhores escolas brasileiras, bilingues e internacionais em São Paulo.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos procurando por um Assistente de Ensino para se juntar à equipe da Young Engineers e2 em São Paulo, SP. Este cargo envolve auxiliar na preparação e condução de aulas, além de apoiar os professores na implementação de atividades educacionais. As tarefas diárias incluem ajudar a desenvolver material educativo, monitorar o progresso dos alunos e manter um ambiente de aprendizagem positivo. Este é um cargo presencial e exige disponibilidade para estar no local diariamente no período da tarde.

Qualificações

  • Ensino e Educação: Formação em Pedagogia, Licenciatura ou áreas relacionadas, além de experiências prévias em atividades educacionais extracurriculares, especialmente na área de educação infantil ou fundamental.
  • STEAM: Conhecimentos em Ciências, Tecnologia, Engenharia, Artes e Matemática são essenciais para auxiliar no desenvolvimento e compreensão do material educacional.
  • Trabalho com Crianças: Habilidades para trabalhar com crianças de diferentes idades, criando um ambiente de aprendizagem positivo e encorajador.
  • Comunicação em Inglês: Fluência para comunicação em Inglês eficazes é crucial para interagir com alunos, pais e colegas de trabalho, pois as aulas são todas ministradas em Inglês.

Remote in Brazil

title: Project Manager
description:
Responsibilities:

Lead the implementation of intelligent warehouse management system (WMS) projects, including project research, business blueprint design, functional requirement documentation, system configuration, data preparation, user training, and go-live support to ensure on-time and high-quality delivery.

Liaise with R&D teams to communicate requirements, track software development progress, and oversee testing phases.

During system integration and go-live stages, take charge of issue resolution on-site to accelerate project delivery.

Maintain effective communication with clients throughout the project lifecycle to ensure smooth implementation.

Summarize project experiences, produce internal training materials and industry-specific case studies, actively participate in internal knowledge-sharing sessions, and contribute to the company's implementation methodology.

Requirements:

Expertise in WMS functionality and implementation methodologies, with hands-on experience in deploying, configuring, or consulting on at least one mainstream WMS product (e.g., SAP EWM, Oracle WMS, Manhattan, Blue Yonder).

Deep domain knowledge in one or more logistics/supply chain industries (e.g., e-commerce, retail, apparel, pharmaceuticals, manufacturing, 3PL) and ability to distill industry best practices.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of persuading and guiding clients and cross-functional teams with structured reasoning. Fluent in English (written & spoken).

Willingness to travel frequently and manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.

Proficiency in SQL Server, Oracle, and MySQL for data querying, troubleshooting, and optimization.

Self-driven problem-solver with a proactive attitude, strong sense of ownership, and ability to work independently under pressure.

title: Power Platform / Power Automate Lead Developer
description:

We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit

Summary

Seeking a highly skilled Power Automate–focused Power Platform Lead Developer to design, build, and optimize automated workflows and business process solutions. The ideal candidate excels in Power Automate, with solid experience in Canvas Apps, Model Driven Apps, and Dataverse, enabling end to end digital process automation across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Power Automate (Primary Focus)

• Design, build, and maintain complex Power Automate flows, including multi stage approval processes, scheduled automations, data integrations, and process orchestration.

• Implement error handling, retries, parallel branches, condition-based logic, and performance optimization within flows.

• Integrate flows with SharePoint, Dataverse, Teams, Outlook, Forms, APIs, and external systems using standard and custom connectors.

• Automate manual or repetitive business processes end to end, improving efficiency, accuracy, and cycle times.

• Monitor and troubleshoot production flows, ensuring reliability, scalability, and resilience.

Power Apps & Dataverse

• Build and enhance Canvas Apps with intuitive, responsive UI, role-based access, and data driven logic.

• Create Model Driven Apps leveraging Dataverse tables, forms, views, business rules, and processes.

• Model business data in Dataverse, including tables, relationships, security roles, and business rules.

Collaboration & Delivery

• Work with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into automated solutions.

• Support full lifecycle delivery — design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and hypercare.

• Ensure alignment with governance, security, and best practice standards across the Power Platform environment.

Required Skills & Experience

• Strong hands-on expertise in Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Automate Desktop, including advanced flow patterns, connectors, and integrations.

• Experience building approval workflows, complex branching logic, and enterprise grade automation solutions.

• Proficiency with Canvas Apps, Model Driven Apps, and Dataverse, preferably with UI/UX experience.

• Solid understanding of Microsoft 365 ecosystem integrations (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Forms, OneDrive).

• Ability to analyze business processes and architect scalable automation solutions.

• Experience working across multiple environments (Dev/UAT/Prod) following ALM best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

• Microsoft certifications such as PL 900, PL 400 or PL 600.

• Experience with API integrations, premium connectors, and custom connectors.

• Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and CI/CD for Power Platform.

Language Requirement:

Advanced English

Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance.

Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of back-end software development experience, a strong background in Node.js, and experience using AI code generation tools to join the engineering team of our U.S. client. Working closely with product stakeholders, you will play an integral role in building an industry-leading product.

The client is focused on greater AI-first development, so a significant part of your role will involve designing and implementing AI-driven features using AI-first development techniques. This includes leveraging prompt engineering to optimize the client's AI models and utilizing cutting-edge tools, such as Cursor and Copilot, to enable smarter development.

As a Sr. Software Engineer, your job is to work between the front-end and product teams to create, publish, and develop clean software. Youll create software that facilitates veterinarian-patient communication and reduces the burden on clinic staff! You must see the big picture of where the client is going and fill in the gaps. Do you actively integrate AI tools and techniques into your daily engineering workflow? Do you support thoughtful discussions and challenge existing ideas? Share what you know, learn what you don't.

Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded and growth-stage, comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new applications and features
  • Build and enhance advanced applications using Node.js
  • Design and implement AI-first features using LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude)
  • Integrate and leverage AI development tools like Cursor and Copilot
  • Provide estimates for features, bug fixes, upgrades, and new projects
  • Participate in clearly and concisely documenting applications and custom-built frameworks
  • Write automated unit and feature tests enabling continuous delivery of your great work
  • Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies (especially AI-related) to maximize development efficiency
  • Support other teammates through good communication and feedback during code reviews
  • See the big picture and support the client's mission of facilitating better pet care

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of engineering experience working on consumer-facing (B2C or B2B), high-volume, commercial software products and services
  • 3+ years of experience with Node.js, Express, and TypeScript (bonus)
  • Proven expertise in prompt engineering for various AI models
  • Regular use of AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, or others to streamline development is preferred
  • A curiosity to explore how you can improve your workflow using AI
  • Experience with object-oriented programming patterns
  • Experience with scaling and performance improvement
  • Knowledge of both relational and non-relational database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB)
  • High execution mindset while balancing the risk vs costs vs timeline
  • Proven history of delivering production-ready applications promptly
  • Experience creating and consuming API's (preferably with GraphQL)
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services (server setup a bonus)
  • Team player eager to learn from and mentor others
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Strong experience with AI-first development methodologies

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Atuação presencial em Goiás

VEM SER AXS!

Na AXS Energia, acreditamos que cada pessoa pode contribuir para um mundo mais sustentável. E se você pudesse fazer parte dessa transformação?

O que fazemos?

title: Technical Project Specialist (Data Center / IDC)
description:
ZTE is looking for The Technical Project Specialist – Data Center / IDC is a hybrid technical delivery and project execution role, responsible for supporting end-to-end delivery of Integrated Data Center (IDC) / Mission Critical E&M projects, from bid support and estimation through planning, site execution, commissioning, acceptance, and handover.

This role operates in a matrix organization, with no direct people management, and acts as a technical project owner at execution level, coordinating internal teams and external contractors to ensure scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, and acceptance objectives are met.

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Execution

  • Support end-to-end project delivery for Data Center / IDC E&M projects, including electrical and HVAC scope.
  • Translate bid assumptions into execution plans, schedules, and acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate site execution activities in alignment with approved scope, schedule, and quality standards.

Bid Support, Estimation & BOM

  • Support bidding and pre-sales activities with technical inputs.
  • Prepare or validate cost estimations, Bill of Materials (BOM), and delivery assumptions.
  • Provide technical and execution inputs to protect project feasibility and margins.

Planning & Schedule Control

  • Develop and maintain baseline project schedules (e.g., MS Project, Primavera or equivalent).
  • Track progress, critical path, risks, and deviations, proposing corrective and mitigation actions.

Site Coordination (Matrix Environment)

  • Coordinate technical activities across engineering, supply chain, quality, HSE, finance/contracts, and external vendors/subcontractors.
  • Ensure alignment on scope, cost, schedule, quality, safety, testing, and acceptance readiness.
  • Act as a technical focal point during execution, without direct people management.

Quality, HSE & Regulatory Compliance

  • Support and verify compliance with HSE, site safety, and quality requirements.
  • Ensure adherence to applicable Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs), including NR-10 (Electrical Safety) and NR-35 (Work at Height), according to project scope.
  • Support audits, inspections, and closure of non-conformities.

Commissioning, Acceptance & Handover

  • Coordinate commissioning and acceptance readiness, including punch lists, test evidence, and acceptance documentation.
  • Support preparation of as-built documentation and handover packages to customers.

Cost Control & Collections Interface

  • Track execution cost drivers and efficiency.
  • Support payment milestone and collections readiness by ensuring technical and acceptance deliverables are completed in line with contractual requirements.

Process Improvement & Digital Tools

  • Support implementation and continuous improvement of IDC delivery processes, controls, and reporting.
  • Promote use of digital tools for planning, reporting, and documentation control.

Stakeholder & Customer Interface

  • Act as a technical interface with customers, internal stakeholders, and partners.
  • Support customer satisfaction through transparent communication and execution discipline.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Center (IDC) / Mission Critical infrastructure project delivery,
  • or equivalent experience in critical electrical or HVAC construction projects with site exposure.
  • Proven experience supporting project execution and customer acceptance in construction or mission-critical environments.
  • Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Industrial/Production Engineering, or related fields is preferred.
  • Technical/technologist degrees may be considered with strong hands-on experience in mission-critical environments.
  • English: Advanced (mandatory) – spoken and written.
  • Portuguese: Fluent (mandatory).
  • Mandarin Chinese and/or Spanish: nice to have.
  • Solid knowledge of electrical systems or HVAC for data centers or mission-critical facilities.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, site documentation, and specifications.
  • Experience with AutoCAD or equivalent CAD tools.
  • Strong understanding of project delivery, execution tracking, risk and issue management, and acceptance preparation.
  • Basic contract and scope awareness related to milestones, deliverables, and acceptance criteria.
  • Advanced English (spoken and written).
  • Strong communication and coordination skills in multi-stakeholder environments.

Mobility

Willingness to travel domestically and occasionally internationally.

Preferred / Nice to Have

  • MBA or Postgraduate degree in Project Management, Operations, or Engineering.
  • Experience in large-scale or international data center projects.
  • Familiarity with commissioning and testing of mission-critical facilities.
  • Experience with MS Project, Primavera, advanced Excel, or reporting tools.
  • Exposure to documentation control, including change logs, punch lists, and handover documentation.
  • Knowledge of HSE practices in construction or critical environments.

If you see yourself in this position and would like to become a part of ZTE group, please apply sending you resume in English version. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Technical Support Engineer - Level 3 (VMWare)
description:
About the Company

Park Place Technologies is a global data center and networking optimization firm. Powered by the world's largest on-the-ground engineering team, a robust group of advanced engineers and our fully staffed, 24x7x365 Enterprise Operations Center, we offer a robust portfolio of IT solutions to optimize networking and data center Uptime and performance. As the industry leader, our 2500 Park Place Associates provide support to 21,000+ customers in more than 180+ countries. We are proud to service 90% of Fortune 500 companies and 40% of Forbes 100 clients. Our company's strength and success are a credit to our Associates, and Park Place Life is how we communicate and deliver our culture internally. We have been awarded as a NorthCoast 99 "Best Workplace" winner for 14 consecutive years in recognition of our employee commitment. Park Place Life is about collaboration, responsiveness, diversity, and integrity, and represents everything that makes our company great and our culture unique.

Technical Support Engineer Level 3 – Wintel/VMWare

The Technical Support Engineer L3 is responsible for proactively responding to the technical challenges and requirements for customers within the Managed Services environments. The Managed Services department is primarily focused on delivering the whole solutions lifecycle, including; Presales, design, implementing, supporting, maintaining and decommissioning data centre solutions to ensure the continuity of business operations for all customers. This role is expected to work with other members of the managed services and technical teams in implementing and supporting solutions for new and existing customers.

What you'll be doing:

· Deliver support solutions for Managed Services customers in line with industry best practice to deliver continual service improvement over the whole service lifecycle.

· Work closely with WINTEL Team Lead to ensure new customers are migrated with seamless handover / transition from onboarding into the steady state managed service environment.

· Implementing new and refreshed managed service solutions for hosted customer environments.

· Dynamically monitor, manage and improve managed service environments. Identifying and resolving root cause of issues and ensuring continual service availability.

· Strive for continual service improvement based on a desire to become a world class managed service provider.

· Contribute proactively to new service development.

· Deliver a high-performance culture in the team with a focus on teamwork, service excellence and ownership for resolving customer issues.

· Guarantee operational procedures and practices are well defined, documented and consistently applied.

· Ensure quality, up-to-date documentation exists for all service arrangements.

· Other duties assigned

What we're looking for:

· Minimum of 8 years' experience in a 3rd line support or administration role, predominantly

working within data centre services and infrastructure.

· Minimum of 8 years' experience with virtualization technologies i.e. VMware or Hyper-V

· Minimum of 7 years' experience with Server operating systems; Windows Server, Linux or Unix.

· Detailed technical understanding of other datacenter technologies including storage, backup, disaster recovery and security.

· Storage connectivity experience within vCenter for troubleshooting

· OEM knowledge-based competencies, preferred.

· Ability to understand and navigate technical situations with strong problem-solving and remedy skills.

· Experience in technical project management.

· Experience in producing low-level technical designs and supporting implementation documentation.

· Experience in performing technical presentations and customer workshops.

· Fluent in English

Bonus Points:

· Vendor certifications a plus (current VCP, MCS Server Virtualization with Windows Server Hyper-V and System Center) – may be required for specific platform support needs.

· Project Management Certification (Prince2 or equivalent)

Education:

· Bachelor's degree required.

Travel:

· 5-10%

calling .

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

PO Sênior – Modelagem de Risco de Crédito (Crédito + Agro)

Inglês fluente é requisito obrigatório, considerando interação recorrente com stakeholders internacionais.

Modelo de atuação híbrido: três vezes por semana (segunda, terça e quinta-feira)

Objetivo da vaga:

Atuar como Product Owner responsável pela condução, priorização e evolução das iniciativas de modelagem de risco de crédito, garantindo que as necessidades de negócio sejam corretamente traduzidas em backlog e entregas técnicas, considerando dois pilares estruturantes do modelo:

1 - Pilar Crédito – variáveis, premissas, regras e lógica do modelo de risco de crédito;

2 - Pilar Agro – variáveis do agronegócio que influenciam diretamente o risco de crédito e precisam ser incorporadas ao modelo.

O profissional será responsável por garantir continuidade, qualidade e governança do conhecimento, evitando perda de contexto ao final de projetos e assegurando evolução contínua do modelo.

Escopo técnico da atuação

Pilar 1 – Modelagem e variáveis de crédito

Entendimento profundo da lógica de modelos de risco de crédito (inputs, premissas, critérios de decisão, indicadores e outputs);

Atuação próxima às áreas de risco e dados para definição, priorização e evolução das variáveis do modelo;

Tradução de necessidades regulatórias, de negócio e operacionais em requisitos claros para times técnicos;

Garantia de rastreabilidade entre necessidade de negócio → backlog → entrega técnica → resultado.

Pilar 2 – Variáveis do agro aplicadas ao risco de crédito

Compreensão das variáveis do agronegócio que impactam o risco de crédito (ex.: sazonalidade, produtividade, clima, ciclos agrícolas, indicadores setoriais);

Capacidade de estruturar essas variáveis como hipóteses, requisitos e critérios de priorização dentro do modelo;

Interface com áreas de domínio (quando necessário) para garantir correta interpretação e aplicação das variáveis no contexto de crédito.

Responsabilidades

Definir, priorizar e manter o backlog das iniciativas de modelagem de risco de crédito;

Conduzir refinamentos e planejamentos com foco técnico e objetivo, garantindo clareza para os times de dados/modelagem;

Escrever user stories, critérios de aceite e dependências com nível de detalhamento adequado para execução técnica;

Garantir alinhamento contínuo entre negócio, risco, dados e tecnologia;

Atuar como ponto central de governança do tema, preservando conhecimento e histórico das decisões do modelo;

Acompanhar entregas, validações e indicadores de qualidade do modelo;

Apoiar decisões estratégicas relacionadas à evolução do risco de crédito.

Requisitos obrigatórios

Experiência sólida como Product Owner (ou papel equivalente) em contextos analíticos, dados ou modelagem;

Vivência prática com modelagem de risco de crédito (variáveis, lógica de decisão, indicadores);

Capacidade comprovada de atuar entre negócio e times técnicos (data science/modelagem/engenharia de dados);

Experiência com metodologias ágeis e gestão de backlog em ambientes complexos;

Autonomia, organização e clareza na comunicação técnica.

Diferenciais relevantes

Experiência com agronegócio aplicado a crédito;

Vivência em ambientes regulados e com forte exigência de governança;

Histórico de atuação garantindo continuidade de conhecimento entre projetos.

Habilidades Técnicas:

- Product Owner

- Modelagem de Risco de Crédito

Habilidades Comportamentais:

- Comunicação

- Organização

Metodologias:

- Metodologias Ágeis

Idiomas:

title: Especialista em Excelência Operacional - Colheita
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Requisitos:

title: Gerente de engenharia de software
description:
Título do Cargo: Gerente de Modernização e Arquiteto Líder de Soluções em IA (AI Problem-Solving Architect)

Buscamos uma Liderança Disruptiva e altamente técnica para atuar como Gerente de Modernização e Arquiteto Líder de Soluções em IA. Este profissional será o principal resolvedor de problemas técnicos de alto nível, responsável por conceber, projetar e liderar a implementação de arquiteturas de Inteligência Artificial de última geração, com foco em sistemas de multiagentes. O papel exige profundos conhecimentos em LLMs, RAG, Deep Learning e experiência prática com orquestração de agentes (ex: CrewAI, LangChain), visando a criação de soluções mais eficazes, determinísticas e com alucinação minimizada. O líder será responsável por guiar e desenvolver uma equipe de 8 profissionais de alto desempenho, garantindo a transformação e modernização contínua dos nossos sistemas e processos.

1. Liderança e Gestão de Pessoas (Liderança Disruptiva):

  • Liderar, inspirar e gerenciar uma equipe multidisciplinar de 8 profissionais (Cientistas de Dados, Engenheiros de IA/ML, etc.), promovendo uma cultura de experimentação, alta performance, agilidade e disrupção.
  • Definir prioridades estratégicas, acompanhar o progresso dos projetos e garantir a entrega de soluções de IA que geram valor de negócio mensurável.
  • Atuar como mentor técnico, estimulando o desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe nas mais recentes tecnologias de IA, Orquestração e LLMs.

2. Arquitetura e Engenharia de Soluções de IA:

  • Ser o "Arquiteto de Soluções de Problemas em AI", traduzindo desafios complexos de negócio em projetos de arquitetura de IA escaláveis, robustos e inovadores.
  • Projetar e otimizar sistemas de orquestração de Multiagentes, definindo fluxos de trabalho, comunicação (A2A - Agent-to-Agent) e protocolos de interação.
  • Desenhar e implementar arquiteturas baseadas em LLMs (Large Language Models) e sistemas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
  • Garantir a integração e modernização das soluções de IA com os sistemas legados e plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP).

3. Governança e Otimização de Agentes:

  • Desenvolver e aplicar metodologias e técnicas avançadas de Prompt Engineering e Context Engineering para controlar e guiar o comportamento dos agentes.
  • Implementar mecanismos de "guardrails" e estratégias de validação para diminuir a alucinação dos agentes, aumentando a eficácia, a precisão e o comportamento determinístico das soluções de IA.
  • Definir padrões de MLOps (Machine Learning Operations), governança e monitoramento para garantir a estabilidade, segurança e conformidade das soluções em produção.

4. Estratégia e Inovação em Modernização:

  • Identificar e propor oportunidades de modernização tecnológica e disrupção em processos-chave da organização através do uso estratégico da IA.
  • Conduzir a avaliação e a adoção de novas ferramentas e frameworks de IA (como CrewAI, LangChain, AutoGen, etc.) para acelerar a inovação e o desenvolvimento de produtos.

Experiência Técnica (Hard Skills):

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada no papel de Arquiteto de Soluções, Arquiteto de Sistemas Sênior e função de liderança técnica equivalente, com foco em IA/ML.
  • Conhecimento Profundo (Hands-on) em:
  • LLMs (Large Language Models) e suas arquiteturas (Transformer, etc.).
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) e otimização de bases de conhecimento para LLMs.
  • Orquestração de Multiagentes: Experiência prática com frameworks como CrewAI, LangChain ou ferramentas similares.
  • Deep Learning e frameworks como PyTorch ou TensorFlow.
  • Arquitetura de dados para IA (Vector Databases, Feature Stores, Data Pipelines).
  • MLOps e CI/CD para modelos e sistemas de IA.
  • Experiência comprovada em técnicas de mitigação de bias e alucinação em LLMs, visando a deterministicidade.

Liderança e Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills):

  • Liderança Disruptiva: Capacidade de desafiar o status quo, promover a mudança, tomar decisões ousadas e construir uma visão tecnológica ambiciosa.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação para interagir com a equipe, stakeholders técnicos e executivos.
  • Visão Estratégica e Habilidade de Solução de Problemas (AI Problem-Solving Architect).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em modernização de sistemas legados utilizando IA.
  • Publicações, contribuições ou participação ativa em comunidades de IA Generativa e Sistemas Multiagentes.
  • Certificações em Arquitetura de Nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) focadas em IA/ML.

title: Estágio em Estudos e Planejamento
description:

Há mais de 65 anos, o Grupo atua ao lado de cidades e regiões para desenvolver, modernizar e operar infraestruturas e sistemas de transporte, acompanhando todas as fases do ciclo de vida dos projetos. No Brasil, nossa história começa nos anos 1960, com estudos para a modernização da rede ferroviária e as primeiras análises para implantação de metrôs. Nas décadas seguintes, participamos de projetos que viabilizaram metrôs, VLTs, BRTs e rodovias.

A SYSTRA Brasil entrega soluções completas em todas as etapas: estudos, desenvolvimento de projetos, gerenciamento e fiscalização. Hoje, também apoiamos nossos clientes e parceiros na transição digital, ecológica e energética, sempre com foco na mobilidade do futuro.

Na SYSTRA, além de contribuir com conhecimento e ideias inovadoras, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em um time de referência global, conectado por um propósito comum: transformar a mobilidade com excelência, audácia e colaboração. Aqui, você terá contato com diversos projetos de mobilidade e infraestrutura de transportes, em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo e o desenvolvimento de cada profissional.

A confiança transporta o mundo, e para nós isso significa criar um ambiente onde todas as pessoas possam pertencer e crescer. Nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas à diversidade de talentos que movem a mobilidade do futuro.

title: Sales Manager-Motion Control & Industrial Automation-Brazil
description:
We are looking for a Regional Sales Manager based in Brazil, responsible for expanding our automation business across Brazil and the entire South American region.

This includes building strong relationships with distributors, system integrators, OEMs, and industrial end users in key markets such as Brazil, Chile, Argentina, Colombia, Peru, Ecuador, and others.

The ideal candidate understands LATAM's industrial automation market, has experience dealing with regional distributors, and can operate independently to scale our PLC, HMI, servo, and motion control business.

Responsibilities

1. Regional Business Development Across South America

  • Develop and manage business opportunities in Brazil, Chile, Argentina, Colombia, Peru, Ecuador, and other South American markets.
  • Establish strong relationships with industrial customers in key sectors:
  • Oil & Gas (offshore platforms, drilling systems, pump control, skid automation)
  • Mining (conveyors, crushers, hoisting systems, process automation)
  • Food Processing & Packaging (filling lines, bottling lines, labeling & sealing machines)
  • Robotics & Automation (robot OEMs, integrators, palletizing/packaging robots, AMRs/AGVs)
  • Identify automation upgrade projects, machine builder opportunities, and OEM/ODM potential.

2. Distributor & System Integrator Network Expansion

  • Recruit and evaluate partners in Brazil and across LATAM with strong technical capability and service teams.
  • Assess integrators serving the above industries (mining automation integrators, food packaging integrators, oilfield service SIs, robotics integrators).
  • Provide training on products, applications, and industry-specific solutions.
  • Jointly drive business opportunities, technical proposals, and commercial negotiations.
  • 3. Sales Management & Project Execution
  • Lead opportunity development from first contact to contract signing.
  • Prepare technical proposals, quotations, and commercial offers tailored to industry requirements.
  • Track project progress (pilot runs, commissioning, FAT/SAT), coordinating with China-based engineering teams.
  • Oversee regional pricing strategy, inventory planning, and distributor sales performance.
  • 4. Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis
  • Analyze competition in motion control and PLC/HMI markets (Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, Omron, Delta, WEG, Bosch Rexroth).
  • Understand industry-specific requirements:
  • Oil & Gas → explosion protection, extreme environment reliability
  • Mining → heavy-duty servo/VFD, dust & vibration resistance
  • Food Packaging → high-speed motion control, hygiene requirements
  • Robotics → EtherCAT, CANopen, servo performance, safety functions
  • Provide structured feedback to HQ regarding product localization, certifications (INMETRO), and market gaps.
  • 5. Marketing, Events & Branding
  • Represent the company at major industrial exhibitions in LATAM (FEIMEC, FIEE, EXPOMAFE, EXPOMIN, Colombiatex, Expoagro).
  • Organize seminars, workshops, and roadshows with distributors.
  • Deploy demo units for partners and key customers across industries.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related technical fields.
  • 5–10 years sales or business development experience in one or more of the following sectors:
  • Oil & Gas (onshore/offshore automation)
  • Mining & heavy industry automation
  • Food processing & packaging machinery
  • Robotics, motion control, and industrial automation
  • Strong understanding of LATAM's industrial automation ecosystem (OEMs, integrators, distributors).
  • Proven track record managing regional distributors and large industrial accounts.

title: Tech Lead (IA)
description:
Sobre a Mobiis

A Mobiis é um ecossistema que conecta soluções SaaS para aumentar a eficiência e promover a inovação na cadeia logística, resultado da união de duas empresas referência no setor: Fretefy e Pathfind. Utilizamos tecnologias modernas, arquitetura escalável e foco em experiência do cliente para entregar soluções que otimizam operações logísticas, promovendo produtividade, controle e tomada de decisão orientada por dados.

A Inteligência Artificial é um pilar estratégico da Mobiis para automação de processos logísticos, inteligência operacional e evolução contínua dos produtos.

Resumo da função

O(a) Tech Lead de Inteligência Artificial (IA) atuará em um papel híbrido, combinando liderança técnica e execução direta (hands-on) no desenvolvimento de soluções de IA aplicadas aos produtos da Mobiis.

Este profissional será responsável por definir direcionamentos técnicos, garantir qualidade e escalabilidade das soluções, ao mesmo tempo em que participa ativamente do desenvolvimento de algoritmos, modelos e pipelines de IA, assegurando impacto real no negócio.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Definir a arquitetura e as melhores práticas para a construção e integração de agentes autônomos utilizando frameworks como CrewAI, LangChain e LangGraph, visando a automação de processos complexos.
  • Orientar a equipe no desenvolvimento de projetos de scraping automatizado e inteligente, aplicando abordagens avançadas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
  • Supervisionar o pré-processamento, a limpeza e a preparação de dados, além de guiar a equipe em técnicas de feature engineering em datasets estruturados e não estruturados.
  • Garantir a qualidade do código, a conformidade com as boas práticas de engenharia de software (Clean Code, SOLID, Design Patterns) e conduzir code reviews.
  • Liderar a implantação de modelos em ambientes produtivos utilizando pipelines em nuvem (Azure), garantindo escalabilidade e robustez.
  • Atuar como ponto de contato técnico entre o time de IA e outras equipes multidisciplinares (arquiteto, design, dev, PO, QA, CSM), alinhando as soluções de IA aos objetivos de negócio.
  • Incentivar a cultura de aprendizado contínuo, reprodutibilidade e documentação detalhada de processos e experimentos

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística ou área correlata.
  • Habilidade para projetar e implementar soluções com fluxos multi-agente e comunicação entre agentes via LLMs.
  • Sólida experiência em projetos de IA/ML, com histórico comprovado de liderança técnica.
  • Proficiência avançada em Python e ampla experiência com diferentes tipos de bancos de dados.
  • Experiência aprofundada com frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch e Scikit-learn).
  • Expertise em fundamentos de IA generativa e no uso de LLMs via APIs (OpenAI, Cohere, Hugging Face).
  • Conhecimento avançado de bibliotecas de manipulação de dados (Pandas, NumPy) e de scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium, Playwright).
  • Experiência sólida e prática com frameworks de orquestração de agentes (CrewAI, LangChain, LangGraph).
  • Conhecimento avançado em Git, arquitetura de APIs REST/GraphQL, e experiência com conceitos de CI/CD e MLOps.
  • Experiência com deploy de modelos ou agentes em ambientes de cloud, utilizando ferramentas como Docker/Kubernetes e monitoramento de desempenho.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Habilidade de liderança, proatividade e capacidade de orientar e motivar a equipe em um ambiente de rápida evolução tecnológica.
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal, com habilidade para apresentar soluções técnicas complexas de forma clara a públicos diversos.
  • Visão estratégica e atenção aos detalhes, garantindo a organização e a validação de pipelines de ponta a ponta.

Desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em .NET e Angular;
  • Comprometimento com a qualidade, segurança e responsabilidade na implementação de modelos de IA.
  • Garantir a qualidade do seu código com boas práticas;
  • Gostar muito de aprender;
  • Fomentar a troca de conhecimentos;

description:

Location: Netherlands (On-site)

Employment Type: Full-time

️ Contract Type: Long-term (1-2-year contract with intention to become permanent)

About the Role:

Are you an Electrical Design Engineer with solid experience in building installations and a strong interest in design, calculations, and BIM-based projects?

A well-established Dutch engineering consultancy is looking for an Electrical Design Engineer (Building Services) to join its team in the Netherlands. You will work on high-quality building projects such as residential buildings, offices, hospitals, shopping malls, museums, and other commercial buildings.

This role is heavily focused on buildings.

Profiles mainly focused on industry, power plants, infrastructure, bridges, or process engineering are not suitable.

Your Responsibilities:

In this role, you will be responsible for the technical design and detailed engineering of electrical installations within building projects.

Key tasks include:

  • Designing electrical installations for residential and commercial buildings
  • Performing cable calculations, lighting calculations, and power calculations
  • Producing 2D and 3D drawings (floor plans, schematics, technical details)
  • Working daily with BIM and electrical design software
  • Preparing technical documentation and cost-related calculations
  • Supporting site measurements and technical coordination (with guidance)
  • Contributing to smooth project delivery and aftercare

Strong hands-on experience is essential:

  • AutoCAD (mandatory)
  • Revit / Revit MEP (mandatory)
  • Dialux (mandatory – lighting calculations)
  • StabiCad (strong advantage – training possible)
  • Intelec or similar calculation software (advantage)
  • MS Office (Excel / Word)

Requirements:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering (Bachelor or equivalent)
  • Minimum 3 years of experience as an Electrical Design Engineer for buildings
  • Proven experience in residential and/or commercial building projects
  • Strong understanding of electrical calculations and building systems
  • Professional working proficiency in English (mandatory)
  • Motivation to learn Dutch standards and regulations (NEN, ISSO, BBL)
  • Valid EU work authorisation (visa support possible for non-EU candidates).

We Offer:

  • 1-2 year contract (40 hours/week) with the possibility of permanent employment.
  • Monthly gross salary: 4.000,00 - 5.000,00 (based on experience and education).
  • 25 paid vacation days + paid public holidays.
  • Holiday allowance of 8.33%, paid annually in May.
  • Travel reimbursement: €0.23/km.
  • Relocation support:
  • First housing arranged and upfront payment of rent/deposit if needed
  • €1,500 - €3,000 net relocation bonus
  • Pick-up on arrival and onboarding support (bank, BSN, insurance, etc.)
  • Team onboarding events and community support.

Work Culture

You will join a consultancy known for:

  • A personal approach toward clients and colleagues
  • Clear and structured project processes
  • Flexibility and openness
  • A strong focus on quality, collaboration, and long-term growth

Each project starts with understanding the client's needs first, followed by the technical solution, not the other way around.

Who is Xelvin?

Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering. We recruit Bachelor, Master, and PhD professionals with backgrounds in Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Mechanical, Automotive, and Physics.

Xelvin is specialized in international recruitment within Europe and beyond. Over the past years, we have supported 1,000+ professionals from 50+ nationalities in building successful careers in the Netherlands.

We hire candidates for a specific project period, after which a permanent contract with the client is intended.

Ready to join us? Apply right now!

title: Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
ZTE Is looking for Delivery Engineer (Quality & Safety by Design)

Role Overview

We are hiring a Delivery Engineer to act as the engineering reference for post-sales delivery execution in complex telecommunications infrastructure projects.

This is a hands-on, operational role, focused on engineering decision-making, delivery feasibility, execution quality, and safety embedded by design.

It is not a people-management role and not a pre-sales position.

The mission is to ensure that what was sold can be installed, integrated, commissioned, accepted, and operated successfully in real environments, right the first time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Validate, review, and approve provisional and definitive engineering designs (PPI, TSSR, PDI, FAM, As-Built), ensuring technical consistency across the full delivery lifecycle.
  • Ensure delivery designs comply with customer engineering standards, contractual technical scope, vendor global guidelines, and real site constraints (space, power, grounding, access, structural conditions).
  • Act as the engineering reference for delivery feasibility, identifying gaps, risks, or assumptions that could impact execution, quality, cost, or schedule.
  • Define, validate, and approve the Engineering / Installation Bill of Materials (E-BOM), ensuring completeness and technical adequacy for installation, integration, and commissioning activities.
  • Classify materials and requirements clearly as included, assumptions, or out-of-scope / change-required, supporting transparent scope control.
  • Validate the engineering quality of executed installations, ensuring alignment with approved designs, customer standards, and best engineering practices.
  • Review and approve installation quality and acceptance evidence, including photos, checklists, test results, quality reports, and as-built documentation.
  • Decide, from an engineering standpoint, on installation acceptance, required corrections, or rework, based on objective technical criteria.
  • Embed quality and safety as engineering premises (quality & safety by design), ensuring designs and E-BOMs support safe and reliable execution.
  • Identify delivery, integration, and acceptance risks early, proposing engineering mitigations to prevent rework, delays, and SLA impact.
  • Act as the engineering focal point in customer design reviews, technical workshops, and acceptance discussions, representing delivery engineering interests.
  • Interface with HSE/EHS, Quality, PMO, Billing, Presales and Field teams from an engineering perspective, translating requirements into executable design and delivery decisions.
  • Support technical clarification, deviation analysis, and root-cause discussions related to delivery execution and installation quality.

This role does not perform field supervision and does not assume legal HSE responsibilities.

What This Role Is Not

  • Not pre-sales or solution definition
  • Not people management
  • Not field supervision or safety technician

This role drives engineering decisions, not day-to-day execution control.

Profile & Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in telecommunications delivery engineering within vendor, operator, or system integrator environments.
  • Practical exposure to one or more domains: RAN, IP, Microwave, Optical, DCN.
  • Strong understanding of installation, integration, commissioning, and real-world execution constraints.
  • Postgraduate specialization in Occupational Safety, Risk Management, Quality, or Compliance
  • Working knowledge of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) relevant to telecom infrastructure projects, such as NR-1, NR-6, NR-7, NR-10, and NR-35.
  • Familiarity with occupational safety procedures and documentation (e.g., basic understanding of PT/APR concepts), from an engineering and feasibility perspective.
  • English – Mandatory (primary working language)
  • Portuguese – Fluent or Native
  • Mandarin – Desirable

Why This Role Matters

Because delivery success depends on engineering decisions made before problems reach the field.

This role ensures that:

  • delivery designs are executable in practice,
  • quality is built into engineering decisions,
  • safety is considered by design,
  • customer acceptance is predictable and auditable.

Venha crescer conosco!!!

title: Product IT Sales Specialist
description:
Product Sales Specialist

Location: Hybrid (Based in Sao Paulo, Brazil)

Join Our Team and Drive Innovation in Cybersecurity!

At GM Sectec, we are seeking a Product Sales Specialist with a strong technical background and sales-oriented mindset to support our LATAM team. This role is crucial in ensuring that customers fully understand the value of our cybersecurity solutions such as: Data Discovery, Data Privacy, Secure Software Development, Cloud Security, Data Loss Prevention, etc.

The ideal candidate will be a proactive professional with a balance of technical expertise and sales acumen, capable of conducting product presentations and demonstrations, engaging with customers, and supporting and collaborating with other sales team members to win the sale.

If you have a passion for technology, customer engagement, and driving product adoption, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact!

Key Responsibilities

Technical Sales Support

  • Assist in product evaluations, guiding customers through solution capabilities and answering technical inquiries.
  • Provide expert advice on Data Discovery, Data Privacy, Secure Software Development, Cloud Security, Compliance, etc.
  • Ensure that customers fully understand the value proposition and impact of the solutions.

Sales Enablement & Product Positioning

  • Develop a deep understanding of vendor solutions, their use cases, and business value.
  • Collaborate with the sales team to position cybersecurity solutions effectively, ensuring alignment with customer needs.
  • Deliver technical presentations and demonstrations in Portuguese, English, and Spanish to showcase product capabilities.
  • Track and report sales performance and provide insights to enhance sales execution and strategy.

Proposal Development & Market Intelligence

  • Support the preparation of RFPs, RFIs, and technical documentation tailored to customer requirements.
  • Monitor market trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies in LATAM.
  • Gather customer feedback to enhance product positioning and sales strategies.

Internal Collaboration & Training

  • Train internal sales teams on the key features, differentiators, and strategic use cases of vendor solutions.
  • Work closely with vendors, partners, and internal stakeholders to maintain product knowledge and best practices.
  • Drive engagement across internal teams to ensure successful product adoption and integration.

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or related fields.
  • 3-5 years of experience in sales engineering/pre-sales, product management, or as a technical sales specialist within cybersecurity or technology solutions.

Technical & Sales Skills

Fluent in Portuguese (native), English, and Spanish.

Knowledge of Data Discovery, Data Privacy, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Secure Software Development, and/or Cloud Security.

Experience with RFP/RFI processes and technical proposal development.

Strong presentation, communication, and customer engagement skills.

Ability to conduct live product demonstrations and address customer concerns confidently.

Preferred Qualifications

Industry certifications (e.g., CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CISM, or CEH).

Experience working with channel partners, resellers, and vendor product sales. Ability to influence and motivate internal teams to support product positioning and adoption.

Why Join Us? Be part of a fast-growing team dedicated to delivering the best cybersecurity solutions to our clients. If you are ready to drive product adoption, support sales efforts, and engage with customers across LATAM, apply now and grow your career with GM Sectec!

title: Analista Contábil
description:
Desafios da Posição

  • Analisar as demonstrações financeiras fundamentado nos princípios GAAP e IFRS, assegurando o registro correto de todas as transações em conformidade com as políticas internas.
  • Acompanhar proativamente as mudanças na legislação fiscal e normas contábeis, garantindo a agilidade da empresa na mitigação de riscos.
  • Atuar com excelência no cumprimento dos calendários de fechamento mensal, atendendo às demandas da matriz, relatórios gerenciais e processos de auditoria.
  • Otimizar o uso dos softwares corporativos para validações rápidas de dados, servindo como ponto de apoio técnico para o treinamento e integração de novos colegas.
  • Reportar informações de forma clara e objetiva à liderança, facilitando o entendimento dos números e a agilidade na tomada de decisão.
  • Estudar indicadores financeiros (KPIs) e dados complexos para fornecer subsídios analíticos que apoiem as decisões estratégicas do gestor.

Responsabilidades

  • Identificar riscos e aprimorar os controles internos para garantir a integridade financeira e a conformidade com as normas contábeis, exigências legais e políticas corporativas, prevenindo erros e fraudes.
  • Registrar e conciliar transações contábeis (vendas, despesas, contas a pagar e a receber, imobilizado etc.) conforme normas contábeis e legislações fiscais vigentes.
  • Elaborar e analisar relatórios financeiros, como DRE, balanço patrimonial, fluxo de caixa e orçamento, apresentando indicadores de desempenho e suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • GESTÃO DE ATIVO IMOBILIZADO: Controlar o ativo imobilizado, incluindo depreciação, vida útil e baixa de ativos, além de participar de inventários físicos.
  • Executar o fechamento contábil mensal e anual, preparando conciliações e relatórios de suporte, atendendo às auditorias internas e externas.
  • Colaborar com as áreas Fiscal, Controladoria e Tesouraria para garantir informações consistentes e tempestivas.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Ciências contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em normas contábeis brasileiras e internacionais (CPC/BRGAAP e IFRS).
  • Experiência prática na gestão de ativos imobilizados na indústria, cálculos de depreciação e realização de inventários físicos.
  • Vivência com conciliações complexas e encerramento de balanços (mensal/anual).
  • Conhecimento avançado em Pacote Office e sistemas ERP como SAP ou Oracle;
  • Registro Profissional: CRC ativo
  • Inglês intermediário

title: Technical Trainer
description:
Technical Trainer (Consultant) – Latin America

CAS uses intuitive technology, unparalleled scientific content, and unmatched human expertise to help companies create groundbreaking innovations that benefit the world. As the scientific information solutions division of the American Chemical Society, CAS manages the largest curated reservoir of scientific knowledge and, for 119 years, has helped innovators mine, assess, and apply that information to keep businesses thriving. The CAS team is global, diverse, endlessly curious, and strives to make scientific insights accessible to innovators worldwide.

CAS is seeking an independent consultant to deliver technical training and product consulting services for CAS scientific information solutions in Latin America (based in Brazil). This is a contract-based engagement.

The consultant will provide pre- and post-sale technical training and product consulting to users of CAS solutions, including SciFinder, BioFinder, and STNext, with a focus on Life Sciences content.

Services will include:

Training & Enablement

  • Prepare and deliver instructional materials for technical training events, user meetings, and conferences.
  • Conduct on-site and virtual sessions to educate customers on CAS solutions and best practices.
  • Design customized educational content tailored to customer workflows and needs.

Consultative Support

  • Provide product consulting to help customers maximize adoption and value.
  • Collaborate with ACS International teams as needed to align training with strategic objectives.
  • Offer insights on AI-driven features and innovative functionalities within CAS solutions.

Customer Engagement

  • Facilitate onboarding and continuous learning for CAS users.
  • Gather feedback and communicate actionable insights to ACS International for product improvement.
  • Support initiatives that promote customer success and solution optimization.

Strategic Communication

  • Deliver compelling presentations at workshops, seminars, and industry events.
  • Represent CAS at conferences and trade shows as agreed under the engagement.

Required Expertise:

  • Proven experience in designing and delivering technical training programs.
  • Strong ability to simplify and communicate complex scientific concepts.
  • Familiarity with CAS solutions (SciFinder, STNext) and other scientific information platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Skilled in virtual training tools (Teams, Zoom, WebEx) and CRM systems (Salesforce/LEX).

Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, or a related discipline (preferred focus on drug discovery or pharmaceutical development).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in technical training, customer success, or product consulting.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; Spanish proficiency is a plus.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Location & Travel

Based in Brazil; with regional travel within Brazil and across Latin America required up to 20% of the time.

This is an independent consulting engagement. The consultant will be responsible for all taxes, insurance, and business expenses. Duration, deliverables, and compensation will be agreed upon in the consulting contract.

  • Conhecimento em SAP e/ou Maximo é um diferencial.

Title : Director - Regional CMC

Location : Brazil, Remote

Experience : Min 15 years in Regulatory Affairs, CMC

Director – Regional CMC

Objective:

The Director – Regional CMC will manage the Regional CMC team, ensuring seamless integration between global Regulatory CMC strategies and local affiliate execution. This role is pivotal in driving regional alignment, efficiency, and consistency in post-approval submissions across a diverse product portfolio, including small molecules, biologics, vaccines, and plasma-derived therapies. The Director – Regional CMC will champion the development and implementation of regional strategies, fostering collaboration and process improvement to meet regulatory requirements effectively and efficiently.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and manage the Regional CMC team, providing guidance, training, and support to ensure high performance and professional development.
  • Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment, promoting knowledge sharing and best practices.
  • Develop and execute a strategic vision for the Regional CMC Liaison function, aligning with global Regulatory CMC objectives.
  • Ensure the team is equipped with the necessary skills, knowledge, and resources to excel in their roles.
  • Translate global CMC strategies into comprehensive regional plans, ensuring alignment with country-specific regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee the development and implementation of regional submission strategies to streamline processes and reduce duplication of effort.
  • Partner with global and regional stakeholders to identify opportunities for harmonization and efficiency.
  • Monitor and report on submission timelines and regulatory approvals, addressing any issues or delays proactively.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local affiliates to understand and address country-specific regulatory needs and challenges.
  • Liaise with global Regulatory CMC teams to provide regional insights and feedback, ensuring a cohesive approach to regulatory submissions.
  • Represent the Regional CMC Liaison function in cross-functional and global meetings, advocating for regional needs and perspectives.
  • Identify and address bottlenecks in the regional submission process, proposing and implementing innovative solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging best practices and lessons learned to optimize regional submission processes.
  • Ensure compliance with regional and country-specific regulatory requirements and guidelines.

Education & Competencies (Technical and Behavioral):

  • BS/BA Degree in a Scientific Discipline, Advanced Degree (M.S), with Ph.D. preferred.
  • 15+ years of seasoned biopharmaceutical/device industry experience or with a regulatory agency is preferred, while leading major submissions during LCM, development - including preparation of NDA/NLA/MAA.
  • Equivalent industry experience with direct technical/product development experience such as Pharmaceutical Development, Analytical Development, Production, Quality Assurance can be considered.
  • People leadership experience (5+ years) required.
  • Highly proficient understanding of scientific principles and profound grasp of global regulatory CMC requirements relevant to global drug development and post-market support.
  • Keeping abreast of industry insights and regulatory trends to drive organizational evolution.
  • Proven ability to understand and communicate regulatory strategy to drug development, registration, and post-market support teams.
  • Analyze issues with attention to detail.
  • Ability to assess and scientifically justify alternative approaches.
  • Base regulatory strategy recommendations on precedents and other regulatory intelligence as well as regulations and guidelines.
  • Able to deal with issues of critical importance independently.
  • Exercises excellent judgment in elevating and communicating actual or potential issues to line management.
  • Understands who is responsible for different decisions, drives and escalates as necessary.
  • Implements the directions taken by the company, leading with agility through evolving landscapes.
  • Intentionally promotes an inclusive culture, leveraging individual strengths for team success.
  • Develops and drives prioritization framework, managing shifting priorities and tight deadlines.
  • Exceptional skills in written and oral communication.
  • Demonstrates excellent skills in leadership, collaboration, negotiation, problem solving, and fostering interpersonal connections through teamwork.

  • Atuar em projetos de remuneração voltados para a operação, incluindo iniciativas de Lean Operacional;
  • Apoiar a gestão, revisão e atualização das Tabelas Salariais LATAM, assegurando competitividade e equidade interna.

  • Experiência prévia em Remuneração / Cargos e Salários;
